newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open little changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open little changed Tuesday, in line with LME copper prices, after a slide to a new six month low Monday.
COMEX September copper was seen opening unchanged to up 0.30 cent a pound from Monday's close at 96.79 cents, after trading a 96.65-97.20 cents range in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME warehouse copper stocks jumped another 4,075 tonnes Tuesday to 268,675 tonnes, with stocks now at their highest level in nearly a year.
COMEX copper stocks rose 1,165 short tons Monday to 39,054 short tons.

Further arbitrage dealings are seen on the horizon as copper continues to flow into COMEX and LME warehouses in Baltimore, dealers said. In the last three trading days, Baltimore stocks have increased 4,592 tonnes.
